```{r chart_percentileDistribution, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

unique_files <- sort(unique(raw_data$app_name))

# Global run colors
unique_runs <- sort(unique(raw_data$run_id))
set.seed(42)
run_colors  <- setNames(choose_palette(length(unique_runs)), unique_runs)

plots <- map(unique_files, function(f) {
  file_data <- raw_data %>%
    filter(app_name == f)

  if (nrow(file_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 20px; color: #999; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("No data available for: ", f)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  subtitle_text <- build_run_testname_subtitle(
    file_data %>% distinct(run_id, test_name)
  )

  # ============================================================
  # 1. PREPARE DATA
  #    - Sample per run to keep HTML size manageable
  #    - Cap at 5000 per run per label
  # ============================================================
  violin_data <- file_data %>%
    group_by(run_id, label) %>%
    sample_n(size = min(n(), 5000), replace = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      run_id = factor(run_id, levels = sort(unique(run_id))),
      label  = as.character(label)
    )

  all_labels  <- sort(unique(violin_data$label))
  file_runs   <- sort(unique(as.character(violin_data$run_id)))

  # ============================================================
  # 2. DYNAMIC HEIGHT — scale by number of labels
  # ============================================================
  num_labels     <- length(all_labels)
  dynamic_height <- max(500, (num_labels * 60) + 200)

  # ============================================================
  # 3. BUILD PLOTLY VIOLIN + BOX
  #    - One violin per run_id per label
  #    - Overlay box plot inside violin
  #    - Show mean point
  # ============================================================
  pl <- plot_ly(height = dynamic_height)

  for (r in file_runs) {
    run_data <- violin_data %>% filter(run_id == r)
    col      <- run_colors[[as.character(r)]]

    pl <- pl %>%
      add_trace(
        data        = run_data,
        type        = "violin",
        x           = ~elapsed,
        y           = ~label,
        name        = paste0("Run ", r),
        legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
        orientation = "h",
        side        = "positive",
        box = list(
          visible = TRUE,
          fillcolor = col,
          line      = list(color = "#222222", width = 1)
        ),
        meanline = list(
          visible = TRUE,
          color   = "#ffffff",
          width   = 2
        ),
        points    = FALSE,
        fillcolor = paste0(
          "rgba(",
          paste(as.integer(col2rgb(col)), collapse = ","),
          ",0.4)"
        ),
        line      = list(color = col, width = 1.5),
        spanmode  = "hard",
        text      = ~paste0(
          "Run ID: ",        run_id,
          "\nTransaction: ", label,
          "\nResponse Time: ", round(elapsed, 0), " ms"
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
  }

  pl <- pl %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text    = paste0(
          "<b>Percentile Distribution (Violin): ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f),
          "<br><sup>", subtitle_text, "</sup></b>"
        ),
        x       = 0,
        xanchor = "left",
        font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
      ),
      xaxis = list(
        title      = "Response Time (ms)",
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        automargin = TRUE,
        rangemode  = "tozero",
        titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
        tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title      = "Transaction",
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        automargin = TRUE,
        titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
        tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10),
        categoryorder = "category descending"
      ),
      violinmode = "overlay",
      violingap  = 0.3,
      violingroupgap = 0.1,
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        x           = 0,
        y           = -0.15,
        font        = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      showlegend = TRUE,
      margin     = list(l = 80, r = 40, b = 100, t = 80),
      dragmode   = FALSE,
      hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
      height     = dynamic_height
    ) %>%
    plotly::config(
      responsive     = TRUE,
      displayModeBar = TRUE,
      toImageButtonOptions = list(
        format   = "png",
        filename = paste0("Percentile_Distribution_", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f), "_", Sys.Date()),
        height   = dynamic_height,
        width    = 1400
      ),
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
        "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
        "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
      )
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
      pl
    ),
    render_observation_panel(
      chart_id = paste0(
        "chart_percentileDistribution_",
        f
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
)
```
